transcript: Yes. I wrote that down. I write everything down. The reader shut the satchel. Tomorrow they'll read it aloud in a doc. All of it. Yours and hers and the keepers. She looked at Kiva for a long moment. I've kept that page in the dark for nine months so that it could be believed. I'd like you to know I've never once been curious what's on it. I'll be curious tomorrow. And for true thousand trobertry. The sifty sefkizes. Teen teen sefted steady seft and south. Place, done place here colder at every epre churn and after Paul's ten with her hands in her sleeves. Going somewhere is not abandonment. Sharing wall method with opponents is the work's purpose. Kiva is glad and will miss her both. Brief shoe, no sentimental swell. Nine at counting house proceeds two at graving tomorrow. Nine at counting house proceeds two at graving tomorrow. indicating fare.
